name: Payroll AD Lists Input
description: Input payroll components (tunjangan/potongan) ke AD Lists Millware untuk data yang MISS

steps.comment: ═══ FORCE PAYROLL DOC DATE TO SELECTED PERIOD MONTH ═══

params.script: const docDate = "${metadata.payrollDocDate}"; const month = String("${metadata.month}").padStart(2, '0'); const candidates = ['#MainContent_txtDocDate', 'input[id*=txtDocDate]', 'input[id*=DocDate]']; const fields = candidates.flatMap(selector => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector))).filter((el, index, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === index); if (!docDate || !/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/.test(docDate)) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate metadata invalid: ' + docDate); } if (docDate.slice(3, 5) !== month) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate month mismatch: ' + docDate + ' expected month ' + month); } if (!fields.length) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate field not found; refusing to continue because browser may use current month'); } for (const el of fields) { el.value = docDate; el.setAttribute('value', docDate); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); } const bad = fields.find(el => String(el.value || '').slice(3, 5) !== month); if (bad) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate field month mismatch after set: ' + bad.value + ' expected month ' + month); } console.log('Payroll DocDate set to selected period month:', docDate);

steps.comment: ═══ HARD GUARD: ONE COMPONENT ONLY FOR ONE DOCID ═══

params.script: const count = Number('${employee.components.length}'); if (count !== 1) { throw new Error('Payroll AD Lists requires exactly one component per DocID. Refusing to combine ' + count + ' components for ${employee.employeeName}. Regenerate payload with oneDocPerComponent=true.'); } console.log('One DocID guard OK for ${employee.employeeName}: one component only');

steps.comment: ═══ FORCE PAYROLL DOC DATE FOR THIS EMPLOYEE FORM ═══

params.script: const docDate = "${metadata.payrollDocDate}"; const month = String("${metadata.month}").padStart(2, '0'); const candidates = ['#MainContent_txtDocDate', 'input[id*=txtDocDate]', 'input[id*=DocDate]']; const fields = candidates.flatMap(selector => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector))).filter((el, index, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === index); if (!docDate || !/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/.test(docDate)) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate metadata invalid: ' + docDate); } if (docDate.slice(3, 5) !== month) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate month mismatch: ' + docDate + ' expected month ' + month); } if (!fields.length) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate field not found before employee input'); } for (const el of fields) { el.value = docDate; el.setAttribute('value', docDate); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); } const bad = fields.find(el => String(el.value || '').slice(3, 5) !== month); if (bad) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate field month mismatch before employee input: ' + bad.value + ' expected month ' + month); } console.log('Payroll DocDate verified for employee form:', docDate);

const value = "${component.componentName}"; const selectors = ['#MainContent_txtDocDesc', '#MainContent_txtDescription', '#MainContent_txtDesc', '#MainContent_txtRemarks', 'input[id*=DocDesc]', 'input[id*=Description]', 'textarea[id*=Description]', 'textarea[id*=Remarks]']; const el = selectors.map(s => document.querySelector(s)).find(Boolean); if (el) { el.value = value; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); console.log('Payroll description set:', value); } else { console.log('Payroll description field not found; continue with ADCode/Amount'); }

steps.comment: ═══ INPUT TASK CODE KEYWORD AND PICK FIRST OPTION ═══
═══ VERIFY PAYROLL DOC DATE BEFORE ADD ═══

params.script: const docDate = "${metadata.payrollDocDate}"; const month = String("${metadata.month}").padStart(2, '0'); const candidates = ['#MainContent_txtDocDate', 'input[id*=txtDocDate]', 'input[id*=DocDate]']; const fields = candidates.flatMap(selector => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector))).filter((el, index, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === index); if (!fields.length) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate field not found before Add'); } for (const el of fields) { if (String(el.value || '').slice(3, 5) !== month) { el.value = docDate; el.setAttribute('value', docDate); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); } } const bad = fields.find(el => String(el.value || '').slice(3, 5) !== month); if (bad) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate month mismatch before Add: ' + bad.value + ' expected month ' + month); } console.log('Payroll DocDate verified before Add:', docDate);

steps.comment: ═══ VERIFY PAYROLL DOC DATE BEFORE SAVE ═══

params.script: const docDate = "${metadata.payrollDocDate}"; const month = String("${metadata.month}").padStart(2, '0'); const candidates = ['#MainContent_txtDocDate', 'input[id*=txtDocDate]', 'input[id*=DocDate]']; const fields = candidates.flatMap(selector => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(selector))).filter((el, index, arr) => el && arr.indexOf(el) === index); if (!fields.length) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate field not found before Save'); } for (const el of fields) { if (String(el.value || '').slice(3, 5) !== month) { el.value = docDate; el.setAttribute('value', docDate); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur', { bubbles: true })); } } const bad = fields.find(el => String(el.value || '').slice(3, 5) !== month); if (bad) { throw new Error('Payroll DocDate month mismatch before Save: ' + bad.value + ' expected month ' + month); } console.log('Payroll DocDate verified before Save:', docDate);
